visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro: A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white furry hat with pom-poms and a white winter jacket, speaks directly into the camera. Her facial expression is cheerful and energetic. The background is a dark, out-of-focus street at night with some artificial lights. (2) Running: The camera follows the woman from a back view as she runs down a concrete sidewalk. She is wearing white pants and brown boots. The path is bordered by tall, leafless trees and a blue stone-textured wall. Small ground-level lights illuminate the edge of the path. (3) Talking in Snow: The woman stands in front of a white building with an external black staircase. Small snowflakes fall around her as she looks upward with a wide smile and closed eyes. A closed grey shutter door with Japanese text is visible in the background. (4) Cycling: A handheld camera shot from behind the woman as she cycles an orange bicycle with a black backpack across a street intersection. In the distance, white cars wait at a traffic light under a grey, overcast sky. (5) Shopping Street: A wide shot of a red-brick pedestrian street in 'Old Karuizawa'. The street is lined with diverse shops featuring Japanese signs. People in heavy winter clothing walk through the area under a bright, clear blue sky. (6) Bakery: Inside a bakery with warm wooden interiors and glowing pendant lights. The woman, wearing her white winter gear, is seen eating a pastry. Glass display cases are filled with various breads and baked goods. (7) Church: The exterior of a dark brown wooden church with a steep triangular roof and a white cross. The scene cuts to the interior, showing rows of wooden pews, a high timber-framed ceiling, and a crucifix at the altar. (8) Male Host: A man with short dark hair, wearing a black hooded jacket and a backpack, speaks to the camera. His face is slightly flushed from the cold. Behind him, the sky shows a soft orange and pink sunset glow over a suburban road. (9) Sunset Path: The woman cycles down a narrow, paved road lined with mossy stone walls and dense forest trees. The low-angle sunlight of the golden hour creates long shadows on the ground. (10) Lake View: A scenic shot of Kumoba Pond with ducks swimming on the surface, reflecting the clear sky. The couple is shown walking together on a dirt path along the water, surrounded by green and orange foliage. (11) Stone Church: The camera shows the exterior of the 'Stone Church', a unique building made of layered stone and glass arches. This is followed by official photos of the sunlit interior with stone walls and greenery. (12) Night Forest: A magical forest scene at night near the Karuizawa Kogen Church. Numerous warm lanterns are suspended from the branches of tall trees, creating a glowing canopy above the paths. (13) Soba Restaurant: The woman, wearing a yellow sweater, is seated in a restaurant. She uses chopsticks to eat soba noodles from a wooden tray. A plate of tempura with a large shrimp is placed in front of her. (14) Outro: The woman is seen cycling during the day, waving. The video ends with a close-up of a white Shiba Inu dog sitting by a wooden door, looking curiously at the camera.
